name: Perth and Kinross
title: Perthshire —
title_em: big skies and the gateway to the Highlands.
tagline: Scone Palace, Pitlochry, Loch Tay and some of Scotland's finest scenery.
summary: Perth and Kinross is Scotland's heart: lowland farmland, big rivers and the first Highland glens. Perth, the ancient capital, is where Scottish kings were crowned at Scone.
The region is known as Big Tree Country and has Pitlochry, Loch Tay and the dramatic Birks of Aberfeldy.
